output.population: 69 participants with three fMRI scans and one EEG session each; EEG session contains sleep data from a nap or quiet wake, depending on condition
output.summary: fMRI and EEG data accompanying a study of rapid eye movement sleep and neural differentiation of memories in the hippocampus, with three fMRI scans and one EEG session per participant.
